description: This file defines structures and functions for managing IPsec XFRM (transform) states in Linux using netlink. It includes data structures for algorithms, encapsulation, limits, statistics, replay states, and the main XfrmState object, along with methods for adding, updating, deleting, listing, and retrieving XFRM states.

classes.name: XfrmStateAlgo
classes.description: Represents an IPsec encryption/authentication algorithm with name, key, and optional parameters.

classes.name: XfrmStateEncap
classes.description: Represents encapsulation details for IPsec, including type, ports, and original address.

classes.name: XfrmStateLimits
classes.description: Defines limits for byte, packet, and time soft/hard thresholds for an IPsec state.

classes.name: XfrmStateStats
classes.description: Holds statistics about bytes, packets, and timing for an IPsec state.

classes.name: XfrmReplayState
classes.description: Represents sequence number state for anti-replay protection.

classes.name: XfrmState
classes.description: Main structure representing an IPsec transform state, including addresses, protocols, algorithms, limits, stats, and other configuration.

methods.name: XfrmStateAdd
methods.description: Adds a new IPsec XFRM state to the system.

methods.name: XfrmStateUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing IPsec XFRM state.

methods.name: XfrmStateList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all IPsec XFRM states.

methods.name: XfrmStateGet
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IPsec XFRM state by ID.

methods.name: XfrmStateFlush
methods.description: Flushes all IPsec XFRM states, optionally filtered by protocol.
